Choose Your Seva

From celebration to meaningful service.

Contributions are voluntary. Support is directed towards practical community-service activities and verified partners where applicable.

📚

School bags, notebooks, stationery, uniforms, books and learning support.

🩺

Health

Checkups, screening camps and support through qualified or verified partners.

👴

Senior Care

Meals, groceries, essentials, mobility aids and care activities.

🧒

Child Care

Support for verified child-care institutions and registered organisations.

🤝

Emergency Relief

Support during floods, fire, heatwave, winter and other emergencies through verified channels.
